$comment: Regras escritas a mao que a GERACAO NAO PODE APAGAR. O gerador reduz cada bloco a um objeto/tipo aberto, descartando description, pattern, enum e additionalProperties:false. Este arquivo e mesclado apos a geracao, com o overlay vencendo em conflito. A validacao de VALOR (origin.id, intervalos, perfil) vive nos helpers via fail(), que da mensagem acionavel; o schema aqui existe para o que fail() nao alcanca: tipo, chave desconhecida e documentacao inline.

node-exporter.description: Subchart do node-exporter. `enabled: false` por padrao — ligar so em ambiente nosso, e junto com collection.nodeInfrastructure. Segue o padrao do guarda-chuva da Grafana: o exportador e um componente, o agente so raspa.

profile.description: own = our environment (collects node infra); client = client cluster (does not). Required, no default. Validation lives in the chart, NOT as a schema enum: the enum fires first and reports "value must be one of 'own','client'", hiding the guard that actually explains the difference and what each profile collects — and the common case is a first install with no profile at all.

spanMetrics.description: RED metrics derived from spans (calls_total, duration_milliseconds_*). Replaces the connector that lived in the retiring otel-collector-client; disabling it stops those series from being produced at all.

buckets.description: Explicit histogram bucket boundaries. Changing them renames every _bucket series.

cardinalityLimit.description: Ceiling on distinct dimension combinations. Beyond it, further combinations fold into one entry labelled otel.metric.overflow="true" (visible, not silently dropped). 0 disables.

dimensions.description: Span attributes promoted to labels. Every dimension multiplies cardinality; k8s.pod.name and k8s.container.name are deliberately absent.

expiration.description: Drop series with no new datapoint for this long.

flushInterval.description: How often derived RED metrics are emitted. 60s floor enforced by the chart: it is the write rate of these series, and cost is series x writes per minute.

namespace.description: Metric name prefix. Empty yields bare calls_total / duration_milliseconds_*, which is what the existing dashboards and alert rules query.
